thread:
devon: Heads-up: staging CI flagged a perf regression after merging PR #4122. p95 decode token latency up ~47% vs baseline. Investigating.
perf-bot: Benchmark alert: job perf/staging/decoder-p95 reported +47% (2026-03-15T14:02Z) :eyes:
mira: repro steps?
devon: run `./scripts/bench_decode --model gpt-medium --seq 1024 --batch 8 --runs 500` — we saw p95 jump from ~120ms -> ~176ms on the decode path.
sam: starting git bisect across runtime merges from 03/14 window. will report.
buildbot: bisect status: candidate commits 14 -> 7 remaining.
sam: narrowed to culprit commit 9f4a2b7 — change was "kernel selection: prefer higher-throughput kernel on tie"
mira: that sounds like the selector prefers attn_v2_block over attn_v1_stream for certain seq/batch combos. attn_v2 has better steady throughput in synthetic long runs but worse tail when KV cache + short bursts.
devon: profiler quick dump: flame shows attn_v2_matmul + memcpy spike and extra kernel launches; KV eviction count increased x3. snippet: ```nvprof summary: attn_v2_matmul 38%  memcpy 21%  cudaLaunch 5%```
jamie: quick local revert of the tie-breaker -> p95 back to ~122ms. can confirm this is the regression. :thumbsup:
devon: can we hotfix revert 9f4a2b7 and hold the rollout? this is a rollout blocker for the decode SLOs.
mira: agree. I'll draft a targeted revert PR and add a unit perf test for decode-p95 (seq=1024, batch=8) into CI. also adjust kernel-selector test to prefer lower tail-latency for SLO class.
sam: opening PR now: PR #4189 — revert kernel-selection tie-breaker + CI perf test. running staging canary.
buildbot: CI: perf regression guard triggered; running new perf suite after PR #4189.
devon: after canary, if p95 holds revert will merge and we'll roll forward. If not, we need deeper root-cause (kernel micro-change).
mira: long-term: selector needs richer cost model (latency distribution + kv-cache heuristics). filing follow-up RFC.
jamie: filing incident note and tagging this as "rollout-blocker". pinging @oncall-sre for visibility.
devon: thanks team — keep updates short here. once PR merges I'll kick an amber canary and watch p95 for 2 hours.
